section_summary.extract_value: This section is a literature review examining the relationship between body image and sexual health in women. It discusses how body mass index (BMI) has shown equivocal results in predicting sexual outcomes, while appearance dissatisfaction has been more consistently associated with decreased sexual satisfaction and function. The section highlights that only two prior studies have examined body appreciation in relation to sexual function and satisfaction (Satinsky et al., 2012; van den Brink et al., 2016), with inconsistent findings, and notes that further research is needed to clarify the unique role of positive body appreciation in sexual health, particularly with age-diverse samples beyond student populations.
